compos.summarization: This smartphone UI screen displays a selection menu for choosing a month. The title "Month" is at the top, followed by a list of months from January to August. Each month has a radio button next to it, allowing the user to select one month. The currently selected month is indicated by a filled radio button (in this case, the first option). The screen also shows the status bar at the top with various icons indicating notifications, battery level, and time (5:59).
